units.title: Chapter I: Genesis of Islamic Republic of Pakistan

outcomes.text: Explain the concept of the Ideology of Pakistan.
Describe its components: Islam, democracy, social justice and equality, and basic human rights.

subtopics.title: Spread of Islam in South Asia

outcomes.text: Appreciate how Islam spread as a social and economic discipline in South Asia and the Ulema's part in it.

topics.title: Pakistan - The result of Muslim Struggle

outcomes.text: Describe the Khilafat Movement, the founding of the Muslim League and the Aligarh Movement.
Explain the Pakistan Resolution, Cripps Mission, 1945-46 elections, Cabinet Mission and Simla Conference.
Explain the Interim Government, the 3 June 1947 Plan, the Independence Act and the emergence of Pakistan.

units.title: Chapter II: Initial Problems of Islamic Republic of Pakistan

outcomes.text: Describe the Radcliffe Award and its injustices and the administrative problems at the start.
Describe the influx of refugees and the division of assets and armed forces.
Explain the water and canal dispute.
Explain the accession of Junagadh, Manavadar, Kashmir and Hyderabad.
Explain steps taken to solve problems and secure national stability.
Describe the Quaid's advice on refugees, civil servants, provincialism, the economy and foreign policy.
Describe his advice to students.

topics.title: Ways and means to resolve problems

outcomes.text: Explain leadership, negotiation, concession, faith, unity and discipline as ways to resolve problems.

units.title: Chapter III: Geography of Islamic Republic of Pakistan

outcomes.text: Describe the physiography and climatic zones of Pakistan.
Explain the influence of climate on human life.
Explain Pakistan's geo-strategic position and its role as a gateway to Afghanistan and Central Asia.
Describe its tourist attractions and read maps.
Explain imbalanced economic growth and regional disparities.

units.title: Chapter IV: Steps Towards an Islamic Republic of Pakistan

outcomes.text: Explain the significance of the Objectives Resolution of 1949.
Describe the Islamic provisions in constitutional documents, especially the 1973 Constitution.
Describe steps towards Islamization since 1949 and the difficulties in implementing them.
Explain the rights and responsibilities of citizens and the effects of breaching them.
Explain the Fundamental Rights in the Constitution.
Describe the 1948 Universal Declaration of Human Rights and the Last Sermon as a charter of human rights.

units.title: Chapter V: Administrative Structure of Pakistan and Good Governance

outcomes.text: Describe the institutions of federal and provincial governments and their functions.
Describe local governments under the Devolution Plan 2001.
Explain the Islamic view of democracy and good governance.
Describe administration in the era of Hazrat Umar.
Explain devolution of power and good governance with targets and expectations.
Identify obstacles to good governance and remedies.

units.title: Chapter VI: Culture of Islamic Republic of Pakistan

outcomes.text: Explain the meaning and importance of culture.
Describe ancient civilizations of Pakistan and the main heritage sites.
Describe common characteristics of Pakistani culture and unity through diversity.
Explain gender equity issues and women's rights in Islam.
Describe policies for women's participation in socio-political affairs.

units.title: Chapter VII: Languages of Islamic Republic of Pakistan

outcomes.text: Explain language as a vehicle of cultural integration and human relationship.
Describe the historical development of Urdu as national language.
Describe Punjabi, Pashto, Sindhi and Balochi.

units.title: Chapter VIII: National Integration and Prosperity

outcomes.text: Explain national integration and cohesion and their importance in an Islamic democratic state.
Identify problems in the way of integration and remedial measures, including one's own role.

units.title: Chapter IX: Economic Planning and Development in Islamic Republic of Pakistan

outcomes.text: Explain the meaning and importance of economic planning and development.
Review five year plans through strategy, targets and achievements.
Describe agricultural, industrial, trade and commerce development.
Describe natural resource development and conservation.
Explain education and health for all and the role of information technology in economic change.

units.title: Chapter X: Foreign Policy of Islamic Republic of Pakistan

subtopics.title: Principles and objectives of foreign policy

outcomes.text: Define foreign policy and state Pakistan's principles, objectives and determinants.
Describe Pakistan's policy toward China, India, Iran, USA, Afghanistan and Saudi Arabia.
Review world affairs and successes and failures of Pakistan's foreign policy.
